Title: Prohibits certain election officials from overseeing an election if they are a part of a political action committee or independent expenditure committee for a candidate
Summary: Prohibits certain election officials from overseeing an election if they are a part of a political action committee or independent expenditure committee for a candidate; defines "political action committee" and "independent expenditure committee".
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the election law, in relation to prohibiting certain election officials from being in political action committees and independent expenditure committees
